title: Juice N Power Passion Fruit Power Salt 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Passion Fruit Power Salt from Juice N Power is an exquisite tropical flavour with a delightfully sweet inhale and smooth exhale. Taste the sunshine with the deep, rich tang of fresh, ripe passion fruit. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
